newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Merrill Lynch 2002 bond issue price at 40 bp over.
newsitem.headline: Merrill Lynch 2002 bond issue price at 40 bp over.

text.p: Merrill Lynch and Co Inc said its 2002 kangaroo bond announced on Wednesday had been increased to A$200 million from A$150 million and was priced at 40 basis points over the March 2002 government bond.
The bonds were priced to yield 7.69 percent.
The issue, which matures on March 15, 2002, pays a coupon of 7.625 percent, and has long term ratings of AA minus and Aa3.
Merrill Lynch is lead manager and arranger, while the dealer group comprises Westpac Banking Corp as senior co-manager and National Australia Bank Ltd and ABN Amro Australia as co-managers.
